description: Fix validation errors of an EN 16931 invoice (XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, UBL, CII) deterministically: empty elements, decimals, date and code formats, specification ids; with totals=true also recalculates totals and the VAT breakdown from the lines. Data that is not in the file (Leitweg-ID, seller contact, endpoint ids, payment terms) is taken from "values"; missing ones are listed in needs_input. Returns the change list, the remaining errors and the corrected XML. Counts as 2 requests.

content.description: Invoice XML (UBL, CII, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3)) as text

content_base64.description: A ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (or any invoice file) as base64, when the invoice is not plain XML

totals.description: Allow recalculating document totals and VAT breakdown from the line amounts

values.description: Values for data that is missing in the file

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms (BT-20), e.g. Zahlbar innerhalb 30 Tagen ohne Abzug

sellerContactName.description: Seller contact person (BT-41), e.g. Max Mustermann

sellerEndpoint.description: Seller electronic address (BT-34), scheme:value, e.g. EM:billing@example.com

name: fix_invoice
title: Auto-fix e-invoice
